title: Let a writable open go ahead without the open lock when its sidecar cannot be opened, instead of refusing
outcome: Let a writable open go ahead without the open lock when its sidecar cannot be opened, instead of refusing
acceptance: A writable open whose `<store>.open-lock` sidecar cannot be opened for a reason other than the store directory being missing (for example a sidecar name past the file system's component length limit, or a transient Windows sharing or lock violation) either goes ahead without the lock or waits as a busy store, and is no longer refused outright as a file I/O error
A regression covers a store whose basename fits SQLite's sidecars but whose `.open-lock` name exceeds the component limit
